summary.text: Lauren McNally represents Ohio's 58th House District, which includes much of Mahoning County and the entire City of Youngstown. In her second term, she serves as Ranking Member of the Commerce & Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: McNally is a graduate of Ursuline High School and earned degrees in Political Science and Journalism from The Ohio State University and Miami University.
She worked as a journalist reporting for NPR stations and print media across the country, and later as a Marketing Specialist for various consulting firms.
She represented Youngstown's 5th Ward on City Council from 2016 to 2022 before joining the Ohio House.
She has served on local boards including the American Red Cross and the Junior League of Youngstown, and is the mother of four.
